Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the death location by “normalizing” it to Passy, Haute-Savoie, instead of recognizing Passy as a neighborhood in Paris (16th arrondissement). This contradicted the opened sources (Wikipedia, IMDb, Wikidata) that clearly state the death place as Paris, and led to prematurely concluding the task with the wrong location.
